name: Javascript Timer API - Timer
description: Uses the Javascript Timer API to provide a timer widget.
project_description: Submodule of the Javascript Timer API (jstimer) project. Registers the 'jst_timer' countdown/count-up timer widget through hook_jstwidget(): it compiles the timer's JavaScript into the shared jstimer.js file, adds the timer format/proximity/redirect/completion settings to the jstimer admin form, and provides the jst_timer_show() theme function used by the datetime field formatter. It is the widget the JsTimer field formatter renders and the reference implementation of the jstimer widget API.
